title: The orphaned tool call
task: Rename the function get_user to fetch_user in users.py
system: You are a coding agent. Use the tools to change files and run tests. Say done when the work is finished.

then.say: The edit was interrupted before it ran. Doing it again.

incident.why: After the interrupt, the edit_file call has a tool_use but no tool_result. The harness builds the next prompt with that gap in it, and the API rejects any history where a tool_use is not answered right after it.
incident.hint: Follow the tool call that was pending at the interrupt. Was it ever answered?

notes.text: Stopping the run was fine; people interrupt runs all the time. Look at what the harness left behind.
This is the API refusing the request. The request was already broken; find where it was built.

fixes.text: On interrupt, answer every pending tool call with an 'interrupted' result
fixes.why: Every tool_use then has its tool_result, so the history stays valid and the run can resume.
Interrupts are a safety feature. The bug is what the harness does after one.
The request is invalid, not unlucky: it fails the same way every time.
